description: For arbitrary unary arithmetic formulas \(P,R\), if PA proves their universal equivalence, it proves the equivalence of the two sentences obtained by negating their values at the numeral for the code of falsum.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticProofPredicates.unary_comparison_consistency
  (P R : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula Unit)
  (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.PAEquivalent P R) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
    ((FirstOrder.Language.Formula.not
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.numeralInstance P fun x =>
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode
              Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature ⊥)).iff
      (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.not
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.numeralInstance R fun x =>
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature ⊥)))
